rust_implementation.placement: programme_v3_1 dependency rule: physics <- design / uq <- assess <- evidence <- cli. abep-assess depends on abep-types, abep-provenance, abep-config (thresholds), and reuses admitted physics crates without duplication: abep-mission (statewise_quantifier, objective vocabulary), abep-gaspath (combine_value_status, constraint_status, H1Tolerance, cite, RFP_CLAUSES, FEED_STATE_FIELDS), abep-config architecture (propellant-path roles, cite). No physics crate depends on abep-assess (crate-graph test).
functions_or_entry_points: abep_assess::thresholds::Thresholds (HC-01..HC-04 from config/constraints/engineering_constraints_v1.json, HC-05..HC-12 from config/assessment/gate_thresholds_v1.json, via abep_config loaders only)
harness interface: binary `abep-assess-parity eval <calls.json>` (writes Python-shaped results as JSON)
rust_implementation.rust_commit: FILL at scoring time (recorded in the report build_provenance, not here)
rust_implementation.rule: the report records the sha256 of every provenance source; any later change is UNRECORDED_SOURCE_CHANGE until a scoring execution records it
rust_implementation.threshold_rule: every requirement limit is read from the frozen configuration through abep-config (engineering constraints: thrust_sustained_min_mN x 1e-3 = HC-01, thrust_capability_mN x 1e-3 = HC-02, p_bus_max_W = HC-03 and the rfp_power_gate limit, wet_mass_max_kg = HC-04; gate thresholds: HC-05..HC-12); no requirement number is a literal in abep-assess and nothing is parsed from RFP text. HC-08 / HC-11 margins are formed against the configured limit (T - D - limit_HC08; min field margin - limit_HC11); both limits are 0.0 in the frozen configuration, so x - 0.0 == x reproduces the reference bit for bit

campaign_seeds.development_rule: development comparisons use development_master_seed only and are never scored or reported as a verdict; every execution with scoring_master_seed is appended to campaign_history and the report is committed whatever its verdict

all_entries.name: outcome, error class and message
all_entries.definition: RETURNED or RAISED; for the registered classes A913RuleError, BoundaryA9Error, OptimizerError and RuntimeError the class and the message are equal; for any other Python exception class (KeyError / TypeError / AttributeError on records outside the documented shapes) only the outcome RAISED is required (Rust fails closed with MODEL_ERROR; DIV-04)

all_entries.name: returned value: keys, key order, nesting, strings, booleans, null, ints and floats
all_entries.tolerance: equal (floats by bit pattern) after the registered DIV-01 transformation
all_entries.definition: canonical JSON of the returned value; sets (E4) as sorted lists; tuples as lists

E15.name: M_n, u_M_n, M_n_lower
E15.definition: IEEE division, pow(x, 2) (= x * x), sqrt and fused-free subtraction; bit identity expected

tolerance_classes.EXACT_VALUE: integers, strings, booleans, null, statuses, verdicts, error classes / messages, key sets and order, and floats (bit pattern): equal
tolerance_classes.ULP_BOUNDED: |rust - py| <= k_ulp * ulp(py); ulp(py) = 2^(floor(log2|py|) - 52) for normal py, the smallest subnormal for py = 0 or subnormal

tolerance_basis.registered: assessment logic is comparisons, copies and IEEE basic operations (feed margins: division and subtraction in the reference order); E15 uses pow / sqrt, k_ulp = 4 (template proposal), bit identity expected

exact_invariants.statement: no constraint status MET_ON_SUPPLIED_VALUES on a value status other than EVALUATED / SYNTHETIC_TEST_ONLY_NOT_EVIDENCE (E2); never a PASS / COMPLY word in an E2 / E7-E12 result
HC-05 is MET or VIOLATED in Rust only on a record with uncertainty_basis AND validation_basis in {VALIDATED_BENCH, MEASURED} (A9.31 sec. 10)
assessment never modifies its input: the canonical JSON of every input record is byte-identical before and after the call (both implementations)

threshold provenance: the Rust HC-01..HC-12 limits equal the abep_config engineering-constraint / gate-threshold values; crates/abep-assess/src contains no numeric literal 1500, 40, 0.012, 0.025, 50.0 or 15000 used as a limit (static scan of the source)
the statewise quantifier is called, not re-implemented: crates/abep-assess has no function named statewise_quantifier and calls abep_mission::statewise::statewise_quantifier (static scan)
double-run determinism: two Rust processes give byte-identical stdout on the same call file

conservation_checks.reason: assessment comparisons; no balance is formed

domain_and_error_parity.cases: edge cases E-07, E-09, E-10, E-11, E-12, E-13 and the randomized refusals

documented_divergences.statement: A9.31 sec. 10 (owner ruling 2026-10-06, after the reference was written): an HC-05 record with uncertainty_basis but without validation_basis in {VALIDATED_BENCH, MEASURED} is NOT_EVALUATED in Rust, while the reference compares its value. Registered transformation of the reference output for such a record: the HC-05 row's status becomes NOT_EVALUATED, value_status is kept, and basis becomes exactly 'A9.31 sec. 10 (OQ-NPICP-02): a model-derived I_e,cap that is VERIFIED but not bench-validated does not satisfy HC-05; NOT_EVALUATED outside a VALIDATED_BENCH domain cell (a measured I_e,cap supersedes the model at the measured point); the record carries no qualifying validation_basis'. Records with a qualifying validation_basis (the reference ignores the key) and records without uncertainty_basis are compared untransformed.

limits are read through abep-config from the frozen configuration (no module literal). Equal values on the registered configuration; observable outputs identical (rfp_power_gate limit_W 1500.0, gate texts rendered with format(limit, 'g') = '1500' and format(limit / 1000, 'g') = '1.5')
callables are supplied as tables (inputs.transport); semantics identical, including duplicate state ids (last entry wins)

records outside the documented shapes (a non-mapping record, a missing required key, a string where a number is expected) raise KeyError / TypeError / AttributeError in the reference; Rust refuses with MODEL_ERROR. Outcome RAISED is required, the class is not scored

Rust verifies the sha256 of the committed RVM / owner-question records against pinned_inputs_sha256 and refuses a changed file (MODEL_ERROR); the reference reads whatever is present. Identical outputs on the registered files

rules: result keys, nesting and order identical

golden_and_reference_cases.rule: references are read as committed; never regenerated (RM-R11)

captured_reference_outputs.sha256_manifest: reference_outputs/MANIFEST.json, written by the scoring run
captured_reference_outputs.purpose: a cargo test replays them in CI after Python is retired

decision_rules.per_test: every scored observable of every vector meets its tolerance class after the registered DIV-01 transformation
decision_rules.verdict: ADMITTED iff every per-test, invariant, domain/error and schema check passes and every reference file matches sha256_at_registration; PARITY_PASS <=> ADMITTED, PARITY_FAIL <=> NOT_ADMITTED
decision_rules.no_retuning: a failure is reported; a changed tolerance, input set, seed or rule is v2 with fresh scoring seeds

bid_boundary.statement: post-bid-freeze work; no output may be cited by the bid package unless the owner re-freezes

what_this_is_not: not a requirement verdict on the architecture: the scored vectors are synthetic / registered records; HC gates on today's raw results stay NOT_EVALUATED / INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE
not a change of any threshold, requirement, frozen dataset or golden
not a re-implementation or move of the admitted statewise quantifier (it stays in abep-mission under its admitted contract)
not authority before admission; not a gate PASS (RM-R31)

classification_gate.rule: LaB6 / conventional hollow-cathode paths are not ported (A9.25 message 3)
checks: no physics crate depends on abep-assess (crate-graph test)

value_status_preservation.check: evidence / value statuses of the supplied records are carried, never upgraded (INV-G-01)
